caption: The drawing depicts a single metal kettle placed near the center of a plain, light-colored background. The kettle is rendered in grayscale with detailed shading to indicate its metallic surface and texture. It has a rounded body with a broad, slightly flared bottom and a narrower top. A circular lid with a small, upward-facing handle sits on top of the kettle. The kettle also features a robust, arching handle attached at two points on its sides, both secured with visible fasteners. The spout is wide, protrudes diagonally from the left side of the body, and tapers to an opening. The overall composition focuses solely on the kettle, without additional objects or elements in the background.
title: Tea Kettle
